source_limitations.extraction_method: Burned-in video captions and chart annotations; spoken explanations unavailable.

incomplete_clips.note: Announces 3 confirmations but ends after the 2nd. The 3rd slot defaults to HTF-bias alignment and is explicitly flagged as not from the video.

primitives.name: Equal Highs / Equal Lows Stop Clusters
primitives.definition: Two or more swing highs/lows within tolerance (default 0.10 x ATR(14)) representing resting stop clusters; tracked as untapped or taken.

primitives.name: Sweep vs Breakout Classifier
primitives.definition: Classifies trades beyond a prior high/low as SWEEP, BREAKOUT, or UNDECIDED using (1) post-pierce candle formation, (2) ATR-normalised approach overlap/body/slope, and (3) configurable HTF-bias slot (not from video).

primitives.name: Confirmed Liquidity Sweep
primitives.definition: Wick pierces pool by >= 0.05 x ATR and a candle closes back beyond the level within max_bars_to_reclaim (default 3); rejected if P2 classifies as BREAKOUT.

primitives.name: MSS / BOS With Displacement
primitives.definition: Post-sweep candle close beyond the last opposing swing with displacement (body >= 1.0x avg body or >= 0.8x ATR) leaving an FVG.

primitives.name: Fair Value Gap + Consequent Encroachment (CE)
primitives.definition: Standard 3-candle FVG with minimum size 0.15 x ATR; entry reference at CE = 50% midpoint.

primitives.name: Inversion FVG (IFVG)
primitives.definition: FVG closed through against its original direction flips polarity; retest of inverted gap is entry. First FVG before the stop hunt on 5M is highest priority.

primitives.name: Breaker Block
primitives.definition: Order block smashed by a candle close through flips polarity into opposite-bias breaker.

primitives.name: BOS-Anchored Fibonacci & OTE
primitives.definition: Anchor fib strictly to the larger swing leg that broke structure (never minor pullbacks); OTE 0.62-0.79, sweet spot 0.705; highest grade when FVG overlaps OTE with directional close.

primitives.name: Draw on Liquidity Target Selection
primitives.definition: Nearest untapped opposing liquidity pool (BSL/SSL, EQH/EQL, session/PD H/L, PD mid).

primitives.name: No Draw, No Trade Gate
primitives.definition: Invalidates setup if target pool is already taken or R:R fails minimum threshold.

primitives.name: 3-Point Turn Validator (Sweep + SMT + MSS)
primitives.definition: Requires liquidity sweep + SMT divergence + MSS. Grade A+ = all 3; Grade B = sweep+MSS with SMT unknown; INVALID = fewer or SMT contradicted.

documented_failure_modes.title: Right time + clean FVG, but no remaining draw on liquidity
documented_failure_modes.lesson: A Silver Bullet inside the window with a clean FVG still fails when the opposing liquidity pool was already taken. No draw, no trade.

documented_failure_modes.title: Sweep + MSS + FVG without SMT divergence (2 of 3 fails)
documented_failure_modes.lesson: When the correlated market also makes a mirrored new extreme at the same time (no SMT), a reversal turn lacks institutional confirmation.

documented_failure_modes.title: Anchoring Fibonacci to a minor internal pullback instead of the BOS leg
documented_failure_modes.lesson: Always zoom out and anchor Fibonacci to the larger leg that actually closed beyond structure.

documented_failure_modes.title: Mistaking an impulsive breakout for a liquidity sweep
documented_failure_modes.lesson: Judge by candle reaction after taking liquidity and by approach quality; strong displacement closes beyond the level indicate breakout, not sweep.
